name: PIM_2_Launch_App_and_Establish_User_Account
title: PIM.2 Launch App and Establish User Account (Function)

statement.label: PIM.2#01
statement.requirement: The system SHALL permit a user to review its Terms of Use before personal data about the user is collected and used.

statement.label: PIM.2#02
statement.requirement: IF account data, content, or device data will be transmitted to an AI component THEN the system SHALL inform the user, before the first such transmission, what categories of data will be processed by the AI component, whether a third party receives the data, and the purposes, retention, and applicable data-use choices.

statement.label: PIM.2#03
statement.requirement: IF the system creates user accounts THEN the system SHALL log the user's acceptance of its Terms of Use before a user account is authorized. See APU.9 for audit log record creation.

statement.label: PIM.2#04
statement.requirement: IF the user is allowed to use pre-existing account credentials from an Identity Provider (IdP) to access the system THEN the system SHALL inform the user, before the user chooses to use those credentials, (a) what attribute information associated with the pre-existing credentials will be used by the system, and (b) what data is communicated back to the IdP at the time of account creation and at each subsequent user authentication.

statement.label: PIM.2#05
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD collect no more than the minimum necessary amount of a user's personally identifiable information (PII) for the purpose of establishing an account, that is, information necessary to authenticate the user, provide customer support, or affect the system's logic.

statement.label: PIM.2#06
statement.requirement: IF user data will be used to train, fine-tune, evaluate, or otherwise improve an AI model THEN the system SHALL obtain the user's permission before the first transmission of account data, user content, or device data to an AI component, and SHALL identify the recipient, the purpose, and whether the data may be retained.

statement.label: PIM.2#07
statement.requirement: IF the system offers optional AI features THEN the system SHOULD allow a user to enable or disable optional AI features separately from unrelated App functions when technically feasible and consistent with the intended use.
